title: Take off Helmet
description: This mod will allow you to take of your helmet whit a key bind
body:
How It Works

Instead of fumbling through your inventory menus mid-climb or during a conversation with friends, this mod assigns a dedicated hotkey (defaulted to 'H') that instantly unequips your headgear.

Why You Need It

This is the ultimate quality-of-life upgrade for roleplayers, builders, and screenshot enthusiasts. It allows for better immersion without the mechanical clunkiness of traditional armor management. Whether you’re stepping into a village and want to show your face, or you just need to clear your HUD for a cinematic view, this mod makes your armor feel like a natural extension of your character rather than a permanent fixture.

Note it will not put the helmet back on since thats alredy a Minecraft feature and it only works whit an empty hand

Keep your protection close, and your style closer.
